ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels to 15% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white region dominating the central and medial lobe areas. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a continuous boundary along the trailing edges and extends into the central notch. Internal low-intensity focal spots and linear streaks are distributed across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated angle of approximately 88 degrees at the vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the continuous linear boundary; peak-to-valley amplitudes are more pronounced on the right lobe, featuring jagged clusters near the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory originating from the central notch and sweeping upward towards the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast yellow-white pixel groups (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; dark circular focal marks visible in the lower quadrant of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple unaligned dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) traversing the white ventral surface, predominantly in diagonal and horizontal orientations.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Substantial barnacle colonization at the lateral apexes; irregular jagged indentations on the trailing edge of the right lobe indicating minor tissue loss or trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct yellow-hued biological clusters localized exclusively on the upper margins of the distal tips.
